raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be allowed to cut down"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "an old walnut tree"
    role location "the user's yard"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "require approval from"
    role subject "cutting down an old walnut tree"
    role object "the local council"
    polarity affirmed
  basis world
